card_en: To say how you feel, use je with a short word for the person: slabo mi je, literally it is bad to me. Mi is to me, ti to you, vam politely. Je never changes.

3.sg.note_en: mu for him, ji for her.

1.pl.note_en: Here the pronoun mi means we, not to me.

2.pl.note_en: Also the polite you: slabo vam je.

quick_check.explain_en: Slabo mi je and bolje mi je take mi; me goes with boli: boli me glava.

helper_de: Exactly like mir ist schlecht: slabo mi je. Mi works like mir, ti like dir, vam like Ihnen.
helper_en: English says I feel sick. Slovenian has no I here, just it is bad to me: slabo mi je.
